title: Make the one-command task-sync read only what changed on fetch, merge, push and memory steps
outcome: Make the one-command task-sync read only what changed on fetch, merge, push and memory steps
acceptance: On fast-forward and after an agent merge, the sync command applies a verified delta from the recorded basis instead of reading the full task tree; a full read stays only for the first trusted read or an explicit rebuild

Before a push, the disclosure check covers each changed document in the newly published history, including data later deleted in that history and dependent retirement targets, without re-reading unchanged documents; the existing case of content deleted before the final tip stays covered
With memories included, an unchanged memory subtree and no pending memory changes is skipped; a changed one reads only the changed keys

A CLI behaviour test counts the task and memory documents actually read or decoded for no-op, pull, push and divergence at the same small changed set, while varying together the task count (N=200 and N=2,000) and the number of unchanged memory keys; the counts do not grow with either
